name: io.agora.rtc.ss.impl.ScreenCapture$ScreenCaptureAssistantActivity
description: The Agora screen-sharing SDK opens Android's screen-capture permission prompt when a share begins and returns the user's choice to the sharing session. Disabling it prevents Android from requesting the permission needed to share the screen.
disableEffect: Screen sharing cannot start because its screen-capture permission prompt will not open.
